# vercel_feature_flag_connection (Resource)

Provides a Feature Flag Connection resource.

A connection lets a consumer project in the same team read the flags of a source project. The consumer reads the source project's flags with its own deployment identity by naming the source project in the Flags SDK. Deleting the connection revokes access immediately, without a redeploy.

Vercel Flags must be enabled on the source project before other projects can be connected to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vercel_project" "source" {
  name = "feature-flag-connection-source"
}

resource "vercel_project" "consumer" {
  name = "feature-flag-connection-consumer"
}

# Lets the consumer project read the flags of the source project.
resource "vercel_feature_flag_connection" "example" {
  project_id          = vercel_project.source.id
  consumer_project_id = vercel_project.consumer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `consumer_project_id` (String) The ID of the Vercel project in the same team that may read the flags of the source project.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the source Vercel project whose flags are shared.

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) The ID of the Vercel team. Required when configuring a team resource if a default team has not been set in the provider.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the connection, in the format `project_id/consumer_project_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# If importing into a personal account, or with a team configured on
# the provider, simply use the source and consumer project IDs.
# - project_id can be found in the project `settings` tab in the Vercel UI.
terraform import vercel_feature_flag_connection.example prj_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/prj_yyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy

# Alternatively, you can import via the team_id, source project_id, and consumer project_id.
# - team_id can be found in the team `settings` tab in the Vercel UI.
terraform import vercel_feature_flag_connection.example team_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/prj_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/prj_yyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy
```
